sentences.en: In the early 1970s, when Marja van Putten was 21 years old,
sentences.zh: 20世纪70年代初，玛雅·范·普滕（Marja van Putten）21岁时，

sentences.en: she lived in an apartment with her young kid in the middle of Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 她带着年幼的孩子住在阿姆斯特丹市中心的一间公寓里。

sentences.en: It was right on a busy road, and there was always a lot of traffic.
sentences.zh: 公寓就在一条繁忙的马路边，车流量总是很大。

sentences.en: I remember there was a nearby school, and you could see before 9 o'clock,
sentences.zh: 我记得附近有一所学校，你可以看到在9点之前，

sentences.en: before the school start, children on their bikes crossing that road
sentences.zh: 也就是上课前，孩子们骑着自行车穿过那条马路，

sentences.en: to go to school at the other side of that busy road.
sentences.zh: 去马路对面的学校上课。

sentences.en: Marja worried about the kids on their bikes.
sentences.zh: 玛雅很担心骑车的孩子们。

sentences.en: Once in a while, there were accidents.
And one day, she heard a collision out on the street.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她听到街上传来碰撞声。

sentences.en: Some people were screaming, and other cars had to stop,
sentences.zh: 有人在尖叫，其他车辆不得不停下来，

sentences.en: and you could hear their alarms and things.
sentences.zh: 你还能听到汽车警报声之类的声音。

sentences.en: So then you run to the window, and you see what's happening.
sentences.zh: 于是你跑到窗边，看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: A girl about 8 years old had been trying to cross the street and got hit by a car.
sentences.zh: 一个大约8岁的小女孩在过马路时被车撞了。

sentences.en: She was luckily not so seriously hidden that she had to be transferred to a hospital,
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，她伤得不重，不需要送往医院，

sentences.en: but she was hit, and the bike was broken.
sentences.zh: 但她确实被撞了，自行车也坏了。

sentences.en: And there was a lady, at that time an old lady, someone as I am now,
sentences.zh: 当时有一位女士，一位老太太，就像我现在这个年纪，

sentences.en: an old lady with an umbrella, like this Mary Poppins sort of type.
sentences.zh: 一位拿着雨伞的老太太，就像玛丽·波平斯（Mary Poppins）那种类型。

sentences.en: Marja watched as the Mary Poppins lady approached the driver of the car.
sentences.zh: 玛雅看着那位“玛丽·波平斯”女士走向肇事司机。

sentences.en: She took the point of her umbrella, and she poked it right into his stomach.
sentences.zh: 她用雨伞尖直接戳进司机的肚子。

sentences.en: And she was screaming at him, and I was standing at the window,
sentences.zh: 她对着他大喊大叫，我当时站在窗边，

sentences.en: and I could see what was happening.
That kind of things, you know, you don't forget.
sentences.zh: 那种事情，你知道，你是不会忘记的。

sentences.en: In the early 1970s, this kind of collision was all too common.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代初，这种碰撞事故太常见了。
制作人德莱尼·霍尔（Delaney Hall）。

sentences.en: There were more cars on the Dutch roads than ever before,
sentences.zh: 荷兰道路上的汽车比以往任何时候都多，

sentences.en: and the roads were getting more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 道路也变得越来越危险。

sentences.en: Growing numbers of pedestrians, bicyclists, and drivers were dying in wrecks.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的行人、骑行者和司机在车祸中丧生。

sentences.en: People like the Mary Poppins woman, and Marja, and many, many others, were getting fed up.
sentences.zh: 像那位“玛丽·波平斯”女士、玛雅以及许多许多其他人，都受够了。

sentences.en: That was exactly the feeling we had.

sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，有些事情变味了。

sentences.en: We said, what did we do over the years?
sentences.zh: 我们问自己，这些年来我们都做了些什么？

sentences.en: And why is it that the car is always number one?
sentences.zh: 为什么汽车总是排在第一位？

sentences.en: I have never actually been to the Netherlands.
But this story doesn't fit with my impression of the country.
sentences.zh: 但这个故事与我对这个国家的印象不符。

sentences.en: It was surprising to me to hear that cars were ever number one in a city like Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 听说在阿姆斯特丹这样的城市里，汽车曾经排在第一位，这让我很惊讶。

sentences.en: Today, the Netherlands has a reputation as a kind of bicycling paradise.
sentences.zh: 如今，荷兰以“骑行天堂”而闻名。

sentences.en: Dutch people today own more bicycles per capita than any other place in the world.
sentences.zh: 荷兰人均自行车拥有量居世界首位。

sentences.en: The country has more than 20,000 miles of dedicated cycling paths.
sentences.zh: 全国拥有超过2万英里的专用自行车道。

sentences.en: International policymakers make pilgrimages to the Netherlands
sentences.zh: 国际政策制定者们纷纷前往荷兰“朝圣”，

sentences.en: to learn how to create good bike infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 学习如何打造优秀的自行车基础设施。

sentences.en: But none of that was inevitable.
It wasn't something that magically emerged from Dutch culture.
sentences.zh: 这并不是荷兰文化中自然而然产生的。

sentences.en: In the 1960s and 70s, back when Marja was a young mom,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪60和70年代，玛雅还是个年轻妈妈的时候，

sentences.en: it looked like the Netherlands would follow the same path as the United States.
sentences.zh: 荷兰看起来似乎要走上和美国一样的道路。

sentences.en: The Dutch had fallen in love with cars,
and they were rebuilding their cities to make room for them.
sentences.zh: 他们正在重建城市，为汽车腾出空间。

sentences.en: But then, in one of the great comeback stories of our time,
sentences.zh: 但随后，在当代最伟大的复兴故事之一中，
自行车奋力夺回了地位。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons why was Marja.
The Netherlands is an amazing place to ride a bike.
sentences.zh: 荷兰是一个非常适合骑自行车的地方。

sentences.en: The country is as flat as a pancake,
sentences.zh: 这个国家平坦得像张煎饼，

sentences.en: and temperatures are mild for a good part of the year.
sentences.zh: 一年中大部分时间气候温和。

sentences.en: So when bicycles first started getting popular in Europe in the 1920s,
sentences.zh: 所以当自行车在20世纪20年代首次在欧洲流行起来时，

sentences.en: they really took off in the Netherlands,
sentences.zh: 它们在荷兰真正火了起来，

sentences.en: launching the country's first golden age of cycling.
sentences.zh: 开启了该国第一个自行车黄金时代。

sentences.en: We have images of that, of the 1920s and 30s.
sentences.zh: 我们有20世纪20和30年代的相关影像。

sentences.en: We have moving images of these cyclists, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们有这些骑行者的动态影像，你知道，

sentences.en: going back and forth over the tram tracks
sentences.zh: 他们在电车轨道上来回穿梭，

sentences.en: and really being playful and enjoying the city.
sentences.zh: 玩得很开心，享受着这座城市。
这是露丝·奥尔登齐尔（Ruth Oldenziel），

sentences.en: a historian who studied cycling in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 一位研究荷兰自行车运动的历史学家。

sentences.en: And she says that in the 1920s and 30s,
bicycles became the main form of transport for many Dutch people.
sentences.zh: 自行车成为了许多荷兰人的主要交通工具。

sentences.en: Some cities even started building bike paths.
sentences.zh: 一些城市甚至开始修建自行车道。

sentences.en: The popularity of cycling dipped briefly during World War II,
sentences.zh: 二战期间，骑行的普及率曾短暂下降，

sentences.en: but then continued its climb into the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 但随后在20世纪50年代继续攀升。

sentences.en: And because streets were relatively safe during these decades,
sentences.zh: 由于这些年代街道相对安全，

sentences.en: kids got used to a surprising degree of freedom.
sentences.zh: 孩子们习惯了令人惊讶的自由度。

sentences.en: We were always outside, and we played in the streets.
sentences.zh: 我们总是在外面，在街上玩耍。

sentences.en: she and her friends learned to ride bikes as soon as they possibly could.
sentences.zh: 她和朋友们尽可能早地学会了骑自行车。

sentences.en: By four or five years old,
they were riding independently through their neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 他们就已经能独立骑车穿梭在社区里了。

sentences.en: and gather at the one house in the neighborhood that had a television.
sentences.zh: 聚集在社区里唯一有电视的那户人家。

sentences.en: It was the first TV Marcia had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 那是玛雅见过的第一台电视。

sentences.en: The kids would just toss their bikes in the yard
sentences.zh: 孩子们会把自行车随手扔在院子里，

sentences.en: and go inside to watch kids' shows and eat cookies.
sentences.zh: 然后进屋看儿童节目、吃饼干。

sentences.en: Neighborhoods where kids grow up without traffic.
sentences.zh: 在没有车流的社区里长大的孩子，

sentences.en: Kids learn to know each other.
sentences.zh: 孩子们学会了认识彼此，

sentences.en: But in the 1950s and 60s, things started to change.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪50和60年代，情况开始发生变化。

sentences.en: There was a new wave of urban planners on the rise,
sentences.zh: 新一代城市规划者崛起，

sentences.en: and they saw bikes as a relic of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他们将自行车视为过去的遗物。
第二次世界大战结束了。

sentences.en: People were buying lots of cars.
sentences.zh: 人们开始大量购买汽车。

sentences.en: And Dutch cities, with their narrow, cobblestone streets,
sentences.zh: 而荷兰城市有着狭窄的鹅卵石街道，

sentences.en: would need to be totally redesigned to make way for the vehicle of the future.
sentences.zh: 需要彻底重新设计，为未来的交通工具让路。

sentences.en: We have a lot of historic cities, Amsterdam being one.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多历史名城，阿姆斯特丹就是其中之一。

sentences.en: And, of course, a city, in order to accommodate cars,
you had to destruct a lot of neighborhoods.
And so there were these ridiculous modernist plans
sentences.zh: 于是出现了一些荒谬的现代主义计划，

sentences.en: to basically erase historic neighborhoods to make a space for cars.
sentences.zh: 基本上是为了给汽车腾出空间而抹去历史街区。

sentences.en: There were a number of plans proposed in the 1950s and 60s.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50和60年代提出了许多计划。

sentences.en: In one case, the Dutch car lobby hired an American traffic engineer
sentences.zh: 有一次，荷兰汽车游说团体聘请了一位美国交通工程师，

sentences.en: by the name of David Jokinen.
He was supposed to come in and revolutionize the Hague and Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 他本应来彻底改变海牙和阿姆斯特丹。

sentences.en: In Amsterdam, Jokinen wanted to demolish a number of the city's working-class neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 在阿姆斯特丹，约基宁想要拆除该市的一些工人阶级社区。

sentences.en: He also wanted to fill in one of the city's iconic canals with concrete
sentences.zh: 他还想用混凝土填平该市标志性的运河之一，

sentences.en: in order to build a six-lane highway into the city center.
sentences.zh: 以便修建一条通往市中心的六车道高速公路。

sentences.en: Jokinen assumed that, just like in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 约基宁认为，就像在美国一样，

sentences.en: most people would want to live in the suburbs and drive to work.
sentences.zh: 大多数人会想住在郊区，然后开车去上班。

sentences.en: Many people were not into this plan.
sentences.zh: 很多人并不赞同这个计划。

sentences.en: They didn't want to see the old city torn down
sentences.zh: 他们不想看到老城被拆毁，

sentences.en: and transformed into a landscape of concrete tower blocks and mega freeways.
sentences.zh: 变成一片混凝土塔楼和超级高速公路的景观。

sentences.en: He became the perfect enemy of the local movement.
sentences.zh: 他成了当地运动最完美的敌人。

sentences.en: You know, he was this brash, stupid American
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是个鲁莽、愚蠢的美国人，

sentences.en: He was ignorant about local situations.
sentences.zh: 他对当地情况一无所知。

sentences.en: To his opponents, Jokinen was like this cartoonish supervillain city planner,
sentences.zh: 在反对者眼中，约基宁就像个卡通式的反派城市规划者，

sentences.en: and he helped unite a misfit coalition of groups who rallied together to fight against his modernist schemes.
sentences.zh: 他促成了一个由各方“怪人”组成的联盟，团结起来反对他的现代主义计划。

sentences.en: These very different groups would ultimately help launch the cycling revolution in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 这些截然不同的群体最终帮助发起了荷兰的自行车革命。

sentences.en: First, there were the local elites who had deep roots in Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 首先是那些在阿姆斯特丹根基深厚的当地精英。

sentences.en: Like the NIMBY preservationists of today,
sentences.zh: 就像今天的“邻避”保护主义者一样，

sentences.en: this group of old-money Amsterdammers loved the historic character of the city.
sentences.zh: 这群老牌阿姆斯特丹富人热爱这座城市的历史风貌。

sentences.en: And for many decades, since the country had begun to industrialize,
sentences.zh: 几十年来，自国家开始工业化以来，

sentences.en: they'd been advocating to protect historic neighborhoods and buildings.
sentences.zh: 他们一直倡导保护历史街区和建筑。

sentences.en: They were really proud of their city.
sentences.zh: 他们真的为自己的城市感到自豪。

sentences.en: They were supporting preservation of the city.
Alongside the preservationists, a number of more radical movements began to take shape,
sentences.zh: 在保护主义者之外，一些更激进的运动开始成形，

sentences.en: including a group of anarchists called Provo.
sentences.zh: 包括一个名为“Provo”（挑衅者）的无政府主义团体。

sentences.en: They declared their opposition to, quote,
capitalism, communism, fascism, bureaucracy, militarism, professionalism, dogmatism, and authoritarianism.
sentences.zh: 资本主义、共产主义、法西斯主义、官僚主义、军国主义、专业主义、教条主义和威权主义。

sentences.en: To give you a sense of their vibe,
sentences.zh: 为了让你感受一下他们的风格，

sentences.en: they once published instructions for how to make a bomb out of a pineapple.
sentences.zh: 他们曾发布过如何用菠萝制作炸弹的说明。

sentences.en: The Provos were not fans of the new wave of modernist planners.
sentences.zh: “挑衅者”们并不喜欢新一波的现代主义规划者。

sentences.en: They didn't want their cities becoming car-centric machines.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让自己的城市变成以汽车为中心的机器。

sentences.en: One of them denounced traffic as a pagan god,
sentences.zh: 其中一人谴责交通是一种异教神，

sentences.en: that the Dutch sacrificed multiple people a day to.
sentences.zh: 荷兰人每天都要向它献祭多人。

sentences.en: At first, the Provos were mostly protesting in the streets.
sentences.zh: 起初，“挑衅者”们大多是在街头抗议。

sentences.en: But as they got more popular, they moved into politics,
sentences.zh: 但随着他们越来越受欢迎，他们进入了政坛，

sentences.en: even winning a number of seats on the Amsterdam City Council.
sentences.zh: 甚至在阿姆斯特丹市议会赢得了多个席位。

sentences.en: There, they proposed a number of policies to rid the city center of cars,
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们提出了一系列政策，旨在清除市中心的汽车，

sentences.en: including what was one of the first bicycle-sharing programs in the world,
sentences.zh: 包括世界上最早的自行车共享计划之一，

sentences.en: And the white bicycle was simply a Dutch, rickety, upright bicycle,
sentences.zh: 而白色自行车只是一种荷兰式的、摇摇晃晃的直立式自行车，
这是马可·德·布鲁梅尔斯特劳特（Marco de Brumelstrout），
zh_words: 马可·德·布鲁梅尔斯特劳特

sentences.en: a professor at the University of Amsterdam
and a co-founder of the Urban Cycling Institute.
sentences.zh: 也是城市自行车研究所的联合创始人。

sentences.en: And what he describes is pretty different
from your average corporate city bike program of today.
sentences.zh: 与你今天看到的普通企业城市自行车项目大不相同。

sentences.en: By painting it white, people could offer their bike to the community.
sentences.zh: 通过把自行车漆成白色，人们就可以把车贡献给社区。

sentences.en: Those bikes would not be locked.
They would be free floating through the city.
sentences.zh: 它们可以自由地在城市中穿行。
基本上每个人都可以参与进来。

sentences.en: For the Provos, the bicycle became not just a practical transportation device,
sentences.zh: 对于“普罗沃”组织来说，自行车不仅是一种实用的交通工具，

sentences.en: If the car represented speed and capitalism,
sentences.zh: 如果说汽车代表了速度和资本主义，

sentences.en: then the bike represented the opposite,
sentences.zh: 那么自行车就代表了与之相反的东西，
一种缓慢而谦逊的事物。

sentences.en: And what they were playing on,
it was this notion of the bicycle being very vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 正是自行车非常脆弱这一概念。

sentences.en: The symbol of the bike really was about a whole new way of organizing society.
sentences.zh: 自行车的象征意义实际上关乎一种组织社会的全新方式。

sentences.en: And it was picked up, especially by artists.
sentences.zh: 而且它被人们采纳了，尤其是艺术家们。

sentences.en: One of the most visible examples of this was in 1969,
sentences.zh: 这最直观的例子之一发生在1969年，

sentences.en: when John Lennon and Yoko Ono spent their honeymoon in Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 当时约翰·列侬和小野洋子在阿姆斯特丹度蜜月。

sentences.en: This was their famous bed-in for peace.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们著名的“床上和平运动”。
我现在不相信这一套了。

sentences.en: Where they lay around in a bed for a week
and had lots of iconic photographs taken.
sentences.zh: 并拍摄了许多标志性的照片。

sentences.en: In those photos, you can see John and Yoko in bed
sentences.zh: 在那些照片里，你可以看到约翰和洋子躺在床上，

sentences.en: with a white dove in a birdcage sitting nearby.
sentences.zh: 旁边放着一个装有白鸽的鸟笼。

sentences.en: And in front of them, a white bicycle.
sentences.zh: 在他们面前，是一辆白色的自行车。

sentences.en: Why did you choose Amsterdam to stay seven days in bed?
sentences.zh: 你们为什么选择在阿姆斯特丹躺在床上七天？

sentences.en: Because it's one of those important youth centers.
sentences.zh: 因为这里是重要的青年中心之一。

sentences.en: With the provos and the white bicycles.
sentences.zh: 有“普罗沃”组织和白色自行车。

sentences.en: We've got details we don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们掌握了一些我们不了解的细节。

sentences.en: We just pick up the vibrations, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们只是感受到了那种共鸣，你知道的。

sentences.en: The provos eventually inspired other groups,
sentences.zh: “普罗沃”组织最终启发了其他团体，

sentences.en: like the troublesome Amsterdammers and the Kabouters.
sentences.zh: 比如麻烦不断的阿姆斯特丹人和“卡布特”组织。

sentences.en: Who created something called the Car Elimination Service.
sentences.zh: 他们创建了一个名为“汽车消除服务”的组织。

sentences.en: They would ride their bikes through the city,
sentences.zh: 他们会骑着自行车穿过城市，

sentences.en: blocking traffic and reclaiming the streets for bicycles.
sentences.zh: 阻挡交通，为自行车夺回街道。

sentences.en: But even though the preservationists and the anarchists
sentences.zh: 但尽管保护主义者和无政府主义者

sentences.en: were a formidable alliance in the war on cars,
sentences.zh: 在反汽车战争中结成了强大的联盟，

sentences.en: in the big picture, the automobile was still winning.
sentences.zh: 从大局来看，汽车依然占据上风。

sentences.en: the number of cars in the country quadrupled
sentences.zh: 全国的汽车数量翻了两番，

sentences.en: and the rates of bicycling plummeted.
Traffic casualties were way, way up.
sentences.zh: 交通事故伤亡人数大幅上升。

sentences.en: over 3,000 people were dying in traffic collisions
sentences.zh: 荷兰每年有超过3000人死于交通事故。

sentences.en: Hundreds of those people were kids.
sentences.zh: 还有更多的人因此受伤。

sentences.en: And even more of them were getting injured.
sentences.zh: 玛莎从公寓窗户目睹的那种碰撞，

sentences.en: The kind of collision that Marcia witnessed
from her apartment window had become commonplace.
sentences.zh: 随着汽车变得越来越普及，

sentences.en: This was true all over the world
sentences.zh: 这种情况在世界各地都是如此。

sentences.en: And in many places, like the U.S.,
